title: Word Ladder
statement_short: Given two words beginWord and endWord, and a dictionary wordList, return the number of words in the shortest transformation sequence from beginWord to endWord such that each adjacent word differs by single letter.
constraints: 1 <= beginWord.length <= 10, endWord.length == beginWord.length, 1 <= wordList.length <= 5000, wordList[i].length == beginWord.length
hint: Dictionary size up to 5000 permits finding the shortest path in an unweighted word graph using level-order queue search.
why_not: Right: Graph BFS finds the shortest path level by level in an unweighted word transition graph in O(N \* M^2) time. Not Graph DFS: DFS explores deep paths first, requiring searching the entire state space to guarantee shortest path length. Not Trie: Prefix trees speed up single-character word dictionary lookups but do not manage shortest path level traversal queues. Not 1D DP: Word transformations form general graph edges rather than linear DAG state transitions.
complexity: O(N \* M^2) time, O(N \* M) space
